name: The Rose Gold Slip: One Luxe Gloss
editorialDescription: A golden-nude lip gloss with fine shimmer, built on Sara Happ's Lip Slip base with jojoba, sweet almond and macadamia oils. The colour is sheer and the doe-foot applicator is soft, so it works as an easy everyday gloss over bare lips or lipstick. Amazon lists it as Rose Gold Luxe Gloss; it's the same 0.21 oz product.
keyFeatures: Shade: golden nude blush with a hint of shimmer
0.21 oz tube with a cushioned doe-foot applicator
Brand ingredient list includes jojoba seed, sweet almond and macadamia seed oils, plus mineral oil, polybutene and beeswax
advantages: A sheer, forgiving shade that works on many skin tones
Oil-rich formula feels comfortable on dry lips
The full ingredient list is published on sarahapp.com
disadvantages: Contains beeswax, so it isn't vegan
A sheer gloss needs reapplying; 'wears all day' is the brand's claim
Contains flavour and saccharin, which some people prefer to avoid
suits: Anyone who wants a subtle shimmer gloss for everyday wear
People with dry lips who dislike sticky glosses
skipIf: You want opaque colour or a matte finish
You have a tree-nut allergy; it contains almond and macadamia oils
buyingConsiderations: Check that the seller is Sara Happ
Read the ingredient list if you're sensitive to flavourings or nut oils
